aliases: Great Northern Paper mill data center

location.site: former Great Northern Paper mill / One North mill site
location.parcel_detail: 13-acre parcel within the roughly 1,400-acre former mill site

status_as_of_cutoff: Canceled. Refreshed 2026-08-11: Nautilus and site owner Our Katahdin announced a 99-year lease and a planned 13-acre, 60 MW Millinocket data center in 2021; Millinocket council packets show local follow-up later in 2021, but 2025 local and trade reporting say the project was canceled/stopped and no current public permit, construction, energized-load, or commissioning record was found.
evidence_grade: B: primary company/site-owner announcement and local-government council packets verify the former plan; cancellation is corroborated by Bangor Daily News and Data Center Dynamics quoting the site redevelopment manager, but no owner-filed cancellation notice or current permit record was located.

actions.government_body: Not a government action; Nautilus Data Technologies and site owner Our Katahdin announcement
actions.result_status: Nautilus and Our Katahdin announced a 99-year lease for a 13-acre, 60 MW planned data center at the former Great Northern Paper mill site, with engineering, permitting, site development, and financing to begin.
actions.access_caveat: Company/site-owner announcement; not evidence of final permit approval, construction completion, energization, or current operation.
actions.evidence_note: Primary source for proposed developer, planned capacity, site acreage, lease, and late-2022 target; superseded by later cancellation reporting.

actions.government_body: Town of Millinocket Town Council packet
actions.result_status: Council packet included a Nautilus Data Center update indicating Our Katahdin was still working to secure facility rights/easements from Brookfield.
actions.access_caveat: Council packet / agenda material; no approval vote or issued permit was identified in this refresh.
actions.evidence_note: Official local-government evidence of pre-cancellation local process, not construction or permit approval.

actions.government_body: Not a government action; Bangor Daily News report quoting site redevelopment manager
actions.result_status: Reported that the proposed $300 million Millinocket data center was canceled.
actions.access_caveat: Local reporting; no signed owner cancellation filing was located.
actions.evidence_note: Cancellation evidence; earlier announcement and 2022 target are superseded.

actions.government_body: Not a government action; Data Center Dynamics
actions.result_status: Trade reporting confirmed Nautilus canceled the planned 60 MW Millinocket project.
actions.access_caveat: Specialist trade report; capacity is a reported project claim, not an operating utility measurement.
actions.evidence_note: Independent reporting corroborates cancellation; not an approval or construction action.

capacity_mw_basis: planned critical IT load from 2021 Nautilus/Our Katahdin announcement and 2025 cancellation reporting; canceled project, not operating or energized capacity
owner: Nautilus Data Technologies (proposed developer/operator); Our Katahdin / One North controlled the former mill site

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.description: 60 MW is a planned/canceled critical IT load claim from announcement and reporting. No utility interconnection, energized-load, commissioning, or operating-capacity source was found, so do not treat it as live capacity.
Cancellation was reported by Bangor Daily News and DCD based on the site redevelopment manager; Nautilus did not publish an owner cancellation notice and reportedly did not respond to media requests.

history.reason: Primary/company announcement and independent cancellation reporting both identify the planned project as 60 MW; retained with capacity_mw_basis caveat because the project is canceled and no energized capacity was verified.
